faq.q: Can I request vegan catering on a Marbella yacht charter?
faq.a: Yes, vegan catering is available on all our charters. Simply inform us of your dietary restrictions at least 48 hours before departure, and we will arrange plant-based snacks, meals, and beverages tailored to your preferences. Our standard inclusions already cover water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, and cava, which are vegan-friendly.

faq.q: What vegan food options are typically offered on board?
faq.a: Typical vegan options include fresh fruit platters, vegetable crudités with hummus, quinoa salads, vegan wraps, and plant-based tapas. For longer charters, we can arrange full vegan meals such as pasta with pesto, grilled vegetables, or vegan paella. All snacks are light and suitable for a day at sea.

faq.q: Do your boat rentals accommodate other dietary restrictions besides vegan?

data.body_html:
Planning a Marbella yacht charter in 2037 and need to accommodate dietary restrictions? Whether you're vegan, gluten-free, or have other food preferences, our fleet of 17 boats departing from Puerto Banús offers flexible catering options. From the compact Mariah SX21 (6.4m, 5 pax) to the luxurious Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax), every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, insurance, and a complimentary drinks package with water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, and cava—all vegan-friendly. With prices starting at €749 for two hours on our Tier A boats, you can enjoy a plant-based day on the Mediterranean without compromise. This guide covers everything you need to know about vegan catering and dietary restrictions for your 2037 charter.

Understanding Dietary Restrictions on Marbella Yacht Charters

Dietary restrictions are common among our guests, and we take them seriously. All our charters include light snacks and drinks, but we can customize the menu to suit vegan, vegetarian, gluten-free, or nut-free diets. The key is advance notice—ideally 48 hours—so our team can source fresh, local ingredients from Marbella's markets. Whether you're cruising to Cabopino or anchoring off Estepona, your meals will be prepared with care. Our standard inclusions already cover vegan-friendly beverages, so you're off to a great start.

Our Fleet and Vegan Catering Capabilities

Every boat in our fleet can accommodate vegan catering. Here's a quick overview of our most popular options:

  • Tier A (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39): €749/2h → €2,299/8h. Perfect for small groups up to 11 pax. Vegan snacks and drinks included.
  • Tier B (Mangusta 80 white/grey): €4,719 minimum 4h, includes a free jet ski. Ideal for larger parties up to 12 pax. Full vegan menu available.
  • Other boats: From the 8m Dubhe (5 pax) to the 29m Ferretti 94 (12 pax), pricing on request via WhatsApp. All can cater to vegan needs.

All charters depart from Puerto Banús, Marbella's iconic marina. For more details on our entire fleet, visit our [boat rental Marbella page](/).

What Vegan Options Are Available Onboard?

Our standard catering includes light snacks like potato chips, olives, and nuts—many of which are vegan. For a dedicated vegan menu, we can arrange:

  • Fresh fruit platters (seasonal, local produce)
  • Vegetable crudités with hummus or baba ganoush
  • Quinoa or couscous salads with herbs
  • Vegan wraps with grilled vegetables
  • Plant-based tapas (e.g., patatas bravas, pimientos de Padrón)
  • For longer charters: vegan paella, pasta, or grilled vegetable skewers

All meals are prepared by local caterers in Marbella, ensuring freshness and quality. Let us know your preferences when booking.

Pricing and Inclusions for Vegan Charters

Our pricing is transparent and inclusive. For Tier A boats, the cost ranges from €749 for 2 hours to €2,299 for 8 hours. Tier B Mangusta 80 starts at €4,719 for 4 hours. All prices include:

  • Licensed skipper
  • Fuel
  • Water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava
  • Light snacks (vegan if requested)
  • Insurance and safety equipment
  • Spanish IVA (21%)

There is no extra charge for dietary accommodations. For other boats, pricing is on request via WhatsApp. Compare our options on the [Marbella yacht charter page](/).

Popular Destinations for Vegan-Friendly Charters

From Puerto Banús, you can explore the Costa del Sol with stops at:

  • Cabopino: Quiet coves and a nature reserve, ideal for a vegan picnic.
  • Estepona: Charming old town with vegan-friendly restaurants.
  • Sotogrande: Luxury marina with plant-based dining options.
  • Cala del Faro and Cala Cortés: Secluded beaches for swimming and sunbathing.

Your skipper can recommend the best spots based on weather and your preferences. All destinations are accessible within a few hours' cruise.

How to Book Your Vegan Yacht Charter in Marbella

Booking is simple. Choose your boat from our fleet, contact us via WhatsApp with your preferred date and dietary requirements, and we'll confirm availability. We recommend booking at least one week in advance, especially during peak season (June–September). For last-minute requests, we do our best to accommodate, but 48 hours' notice is ideal for vegan catering. Start your journey by visiting our [main page](/).

Frequently Asked Questions

Can I request vegan catering on a Marbella yacht charter?

Yes, vegan catering is available on all our charters. Simply inform us of your dietary restrictions at least 48 hours before departure, and we will arrange plant-based snacks, meals, and beverages tailored to your preferences. Our standard inclusions already cover water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, and cava, which are vegan-friendly.

Typical vegan options include fresh fruit platters, vegetable crudités with hummus, quinoa salads, vegan wraps, and plant-based tapas. For longer charters, we can arrange full vegan meals such as pasta with pesto, grilled vegetables, or vegan paella. All snacks are light and suitable for a day at sea.

Absolutely. We can cater to gluten-free, nut-free, dairy-free, and other dietary needs. Please specify your requirements when booking. Our team works with local caterers in Puerto Banús to ensure your meals are safe, delicious, and aligned with your health needs.

Yes, the standard drinks package—water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, and cava—is entirely vegan. We do not serve any animal products in our complimentary beverages. If you require additional vegan drinks like plant-based milk or specific juices, let us know in advance.

We recommend providing at least 48 hours' notice for any dietary restrictions, including vegan catering. This allows us to coordinate with our suppliers in Marbella and ensure fresh, high-quality ingredients are prepared. Last-minute requests may be possible but cannot be guaranteed.

Yes, you are welcome to bring your own food and drinks on board. However, our inclusive packages already cover snacks and beverages, so you may not need to. If you have specific vegan brands or items you prefer, feel free to bring them. Our skipper can store them in the galley fridge.

Yes, vegan catering can be arranged for any boat in our fleet, from the 6.4m Mariah SX21 to the 29m Ferretti 94. The same dietary accommodation applies regardless of boat size. Just let us know your needs when booking, and we will customize the menu accordingly.

For other boats, pricing is on request via WhatsApp. There is no extra charge for dietary accommodations; the cost is covered by the inclusive package. Special requests beyond the standard menu may incur a small supplementary fee.
